findings.state_law: Gov. Code § 66321(b)(2): a local maximum must still allow 850 sq ft of interior livable space, or 1,000 sq ft for an ADU with more than one bedroom. These figures protect what local maximums must allow; they are not required minimum unit sizes. Qualifying § 66323(a)(1) conversions are not subject to unit-size limits.
